ar.name: Arkansas (statewide)
ar.bounds: Every Arkansas waterfowl season is statewide.
ar.note: One zone. WMAs end shooting at noon (Nov 21 – Jan 30) and set their own access times.

seasonsNote: Every season is statewide. On WMAs waterfowl shooting ends at noon from Nov 21 to Jan 30 (except where the guidebook says otherwise).

seasons.label: Teal — special early
seasons.note: Blue-winged, green-winged and cinnamon teal; shooting from sunrise.

seasons.label: Light and white-fronted geese
seasons.note: Snow, blue and Ross’s geese (and white-fronted geese). Light Goose Conservation Order Feb 1–5 and Feb 8 – Apr 25, 2027 (no limit).

bags.detail: Six ducks, inside which the limits below apply. Possession three times the daily limit.
Light geese 20 (no possession limit); white-fronted geese 2.
Youths 15 and under; mentor 21+ if no hunter education (the mentor may call but not hunt). WMAs open to sunset.
Proof of service required; WMAs open to sunset.

duckSublimits.note: their own limit; no more than 2 hooded
up to the full bag (teal included)

rules.d: On WMAs waterfowl shooting runs 30 minutes before sunrise to noon from Nov 21 to Jan 30; to sunset on Jan 31 and Feb 6–7. Hunters must be off water-inundated areas by 1 p.m. (noon on Dave Donaldson Black River and George H. Dunklin Jr. Bayou Meto WMAs) Nov 22 – Jan 30, and by 6:30 p.m. Jan 31 and Feb 7–8.
Federally approved non-toxic shot for ducks, geese and mergansers statewide, and for all migratory birds on many WMAs (Bell Slough, Big Lake, Bayou Meto, Black River, Seven Devils and others).

No guiding for pay on WMAs or NWRs. No decoys, dog stands or platforms left overnight. No permanent blinds. No cutting tools or defoliants on Commission-owned WMAs. A free WMA General Use permit for all hunters. AGFC waterfowl rest areas are red on the map.
Single file, no passing, at least 100 feet between boats; hazardous operation carries fines and a WMA ban.
Feb 6–7, 2027 (no shot-shell limits on WMAs; hunting to sunset).
Leave the head or one fully feathered wing on until you get home, and tag birds left with anyone else (federal rules).

licences.d: Non-resident $50 (DSN); resident price not on the page.
3-day $40 (up to 10) or 30-day $200, valid on open regular-season days.

licences.d: HIP for all migratory bird hunters; federal stamp for hunters 16+.
